description: Add a quick filter chip to a space (omit `quick_filter`; `name` required) or change one (name, color_index 0-9, conditions, condition_match). Its conditions may mix task, event and note fields: each section applies the ones of its own kind. Validated and written like set_space; dry_run:true writes nothing.

color_index.description:
Chip colour, an index from 0 to 9 into the app's quick-filter
palette; -1 clears it.

condition_match.description: How the conditions combine: all, any or none.

conditions.description:
Filter conditions `{type, operator, value}` as the app writes them;
task, event and note conditions may mix. Replaces the conditions.

quick_filter.description:
The quick filter to change (id or name). Omit to add one, which then
needs `name`.

name: set_quick_filter
